findings.acceptance: API v1.0 envelope and endpoint response validation
findings.title: Envelope requestId and read diagnostics item schema are not validated
findings.evidence: The handoff contract requires requestId on success and error envelopes. request() validates apiVersion and data but not requestId. read() validates diagnostics only as a list; assistant_tools.py line 175 calls item.get() without a per-item type guard, allowing malformed data to escape as AttributeError.
findings.requested_fix: Validate a non-empty requestId in response envelopes; validate each read diagnostics item and required code/message types before returning.

findings.acceptance: Dual evidence: readable human report plus JSON sidecar
findings.title: Worker r2 human report is corrupted with literal question marks
findings.evidence: UTF-8 inspection found 281 literal ASCII question marks, including in the title and report body. The JSON sidecar does not replace the required readable human report.
findings.requested_fix: Regenerate the Markdown report as readable Chinese and keep its claims consistent with the JSON sidecar.
